projects.title: Data Storage Cluster Fault Prediction and Analysis
projects.description:
Use statistics and machine learning to predict faults in data storage clusters

This system collects data from various sources, including log files, Linux systems tools, sends them to a distributed system for translation, then to a search engine.   We use various statistical and machine learning models, as well as graphical presentations, to find indicators of impending faults.

projects.title: SCIMITAR
projects.description: Prototyped a distributed pub-sub-query information management system and demonstrated horizontal scalability within Amazon EC2. This system consisted of an information brokering service built with Storm and an archive-query service built with MongoDB.
